serviceDiscovery.description: Shared lib-service-discovery (Consul, advertise model) knobs, set once per environment and consumed by the systemplanes + adapter-provider-mock via the chart-local plugin-br-pix-lerian.serviceDiscovery.env helper. The per-app advertise pair (SD_ADVERTISE_ADDRESS/PORT) is derived from each component's identity, not from here.

enabled.description: SD_ENABLED — turn service discovery on for the components that emit the shared knobs.

address.description: SD_ADDRESS — Consul HTTP API host:port (no scheme).

tls.description: SD_TLS — use TLS to reach Consul.

tlsSkipVerify.description: SD_TLS_SKIP_VERIFY — skip Consul TLS certificate verification.

workload.description: SD_WORKLOAD — per-env workload tag scoping Consul service names.

streaming.description: Shared lib-streaming (RedPanda) contract. enabled drives STREAMING_ENABLED for the streaming components (spi/dict-hub/cob-hub/pixauto) once per environment; a component's own configmap.STREAMING_ENABLED still wins. Transport fields (brokers, sasl*, tls*) feed lerian-common.streaming.env.

enabled.description: STREAMING_ENABLED — turn streaming on for spi/dict-hub/cob-hub/pixauto.

observability.description: Shared observability (OTel) contract. enabled drives ENABLE_TELEMETRY (via lerian-common.otel.env) AND the deployment's node-local HOST_IP + OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT downward-API wiring (via lerian-common.globalValue, default true). A component's own configmap.ENABLE_TELEMETRY still wins.

enabled.description: ENABLE_TELEMETRY — turn telemetry on/off for all components.

items.description: Database name, used verbatim in PostgreSQL and as the suffix of the bootstrap Job name plugin-br-pix-lerian-bootstrap-postgres-<database>. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only; must start and end with a letter or digit; no underscore, dot or uppercase. maxLength is 23 because the 40-character Job name prefix plus the name must stay within the 63-character DNS-1123 label limit. The value is never normalized: what you write here is the database created in PostgreSQL.

allOf.title: retired credentials key
allOf.description: global.externalPostgresDefinitions.pixswitchCredentials was renamed to pixLerianCredentials. There is no alias: rename the key in your values. Expressed as a false subschema on the property rather than a top-level 'not', so Helm's validator names the offending path (/global/externalPostgresDefinitions/pixswitchCredentials) instead of only reporting that a 'not' failed.
